calls.title: Chris / Scott
calls.summary: The meeting highlighted significant priorities for Growth Book, including the urgent need for sales enablement tools like battle cards and pitch decks to counter competitors such as LaunchDarkly and Optimizely. It was noted that current sales collateral is outdated, creating inefficiencies during pre-sales and onboarding, with a push for centralized, targeted materials. Additionally, customer onboarding experiences vary widely based on user savviness, necessitating tailored support to enhance renewal success. Growth Book's headcount grew significantly within a short timeframe, heightening the demand for coordinated marketing and sales strategies. Participants emphasized a reactive product development roadmap driven by immediate customer requests and a growing focus on integrating AI meaningfully into the product landscape.
calls.keywords: Technical PMM, Sales Enablement, Battle Cards, AI Roadmap, Customer Onboarding, Competitive Intelligence
calls.action_items:
**Scott Bailey**
Collaborate with Elise to establish a Notion database for logging and prioritizing marketing requests (13:03)
Flag the urgency of creating battle cards and sales pitch decks for leadership (28:09)
Develop marketing content focused on AI capabilities, including customer research for AI roadmap (31:47)
Coordinate with sales and Go-to-Market teams for workflow/process on request prioritization and execution (36:02)
Share docs improvement suggestions for managed warehouse content (09:29)
Prepare website assets showcasing MCP server integration with Claude code (35:20)

**Chris Sanders**
Provide examples of competitive issues and requests encountered in sales to inform battle card priorities (13:55)
Engage in creating/improving sales enablement materials such as onboarding decks for developers and experimentation culture decks (21:37)
Continue involvement in pre-sales and post-sales customer onboarding and enablement focusing on larger enterprise customers (17:28)
Communicate needs and gaps in existing decks and sales materials to marketing team (36:02)
